name: National Domestic Violence Hotline
blurb: You want anonymous support or are not sure where to start.
blurbEs: Quieres apoyo anónimo o no sabes por dónde empezar.
notes: 24/7 phone, chat and text with advocates; safety planning; referrals
whenToUse: You want anonymous support or are not sure where to start. Works while a partner is nearby if you use chat or text.
channelNotes: Chat at thehotline.org; text START to 88788.

name: CalVCB (California Victim Compensation Board)
blurb: You want help paying for relocation, counseling or medical costs.
blurbEs: Quieres ayuda para pagar una mudanza, terapia o gastos médicos.
notes: Pays crime-related costs not covered elsewhere: relocation, mental health, medical, dental, home security.
accessNote: Apply online (EN/ES) or by paper; an advocate can help via victims.ca.gov/get-help. Relay: 711.
whenToUse: You want help paying for relocation, counseling or medical costs. Application can be started while partner is home, but keep any paperwork where it can't be found.
channelNotes: Apply online (English/Spanish); no police report needed.

name: California Safe at Home (Secretary of State)
blurb: You want your new address kept confidential.
blurbEs: Quieres que tu nueva dirección se mantenga confidencial.
notes: Substitute mailing address accepted by state/county/city agencies; confidential voter registration.
accessNote: Enroll by appointment with a designated Enrolling Agency (look-up on the SOS site). Email SafeAtHome@sos.ca.gov. Also (916) 653-6814.
whenToUse: You want your new address kept confidential.
channelNotes: Requires an appointment with an enrolling agency.

name: NNEDV Safety Net (technology safety)
blurb: You think your phone or accounts are being monitored.

accessNote: Page advises clearing browser history after visiting if your device is monitored.
whenToUse: You think your phone or accounts are being monitored.
channelNotes: Read on a safer device. Clear browser history afterward.
